Richard Seidl hosts interviews and podcasts them on Software Testing Unleashed. This one happened at EuroSTAR 2026, on June 18, and was released on November 2, 2026.

Testing AI Models as Magic Boxes: Why Checks FailA language model is a box that nobody controls or fully understands. Testing AI models therefore means exploring, experimenting and weighing the risk.

And if you’re walking, jogging, biking, or driving, please watch it later! But you can hear it on Apple Podcasts or Spotify.
